package com.gymie.workout.infrastructure.presentation.web.converters

import com.gymie.workout.core.domain.workout.SetWeight
import com.gymie.workout.core.exceptions.WorkoutValidationException
import com.gymie.workout.infrastructure.presentation.web.dto.SetWeightDto

/**
 * The single place [SetWeightDto] (the wire shape) and [SetWeight] (the domain type) meet — and
 * therefore the single place the wire shape's rule is stated: `kind` is one of the two known
 * constants, and `value` is present exactly when `kind` is `MEASURED`.
 *
 * Both writers of a set's weight go through here — the whole-workout `POST`/`PUT` via
 * `WorkoutRequestValidator` and `WorkoutWebConverters`, and `PATCH /{id}/sets/{setId}` via the
 * controller — so neither can accept a shape the other refuses. Every refusal is a
 * [WorkoutValidationException], which this module's own `WorkoutExceptionHandler` maps to `400`;
 * a bare `IllegalArgumentException` here would leave `:workout`'s input contract depending on an
 * unscoped advice in an unrelated module, and would surface as a `500` in a controller slice.
 *
 * No unit crosses here in either direction: a set carries a number, its workout carries the unit.
 * Nothing converts a number, so a weight is stored, and read back, as the one the user typed.
 */
object SetWeightWebConverter {
    fun toDomain(dto: SetWeightDto?): SetWeight? =
        when (dto?.kind) {
            null -> null
            SetWeightDto.KIND_BODYWEIGHT -> bodyweight(dto)
            SetWeightDto.KIND_MEASURED -> measured(dto)
            else -> throw WorkoutValidationException("Weight kind must be MEASURED or BW")
        }

    private fun bodyweight(dto: SetWeightDto): SetWeight {
        if (dto.value != null) throw WorkoutValidationException("A BW weight must not carry a value")
        return SetWeight.Bodyweight
    }

    private fun measured(dto: SetWeightDto): SetWeight {
        val value = dto.value ?: throw WorkoutValidationException("A MEASURED weight requires a value")
        return SetWeight.Measured(value)
    }

    fun toDto(weight: SetWeight?): SetWeightDto? =
        when (weight) {
            null -> null
            is SetWeight.Bodyweight -> SetWeightDto(kind = SetWeightDto.KIND_BODYWEIGHT)
            is SetWeight.Measured -> SetWeightDto(kind = SetWeightDto.KIND_MEASURED, value = weight.value)
        }
}

42: * always the one the participant row names, and never something the client could substitute.
43: * [resolve]/[resolveForWrite] are also the sole gate: they are what turns a `VIEW` viewer (403
44: * `edit_access_required`) or non-participant caller (404) away before any `:workout` service ever
45: * runs, and [resolveForWrite] additionally turns a lowered or revoked `WORKOUTS: EDIT` grant into `403` for every
46: * write route (design § 4).

48: * No `start`, `delete`, `copy` or `list`: starting a participant's workout is the session's own
49: * action, deleting or copying one is not the floor's concern, and the session detail already lists
50: * every participant's workout.

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice

@RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes = [GroupSessionController::class, GroupSessionWorkoutController::class])
class GroupSessionExceptionHandler(
    private val queryService: GroupSessionQueryService,
) {
    @ExceptionHandler(GroupSessionNotFoundException::class)
    fun handleNotFound(ex: GroupSessionNotFoundException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.message ?: "Group session not found")

    /**
     * A participant's workout that the `:workout` module can no longer find, once
     * [GroupSessionWorkoutController.resolve][GroupSessionWorkoutController] has already confirmed
     * the caller owns the session and the target is a participant. Mapped here, in `:groupsession`,
     * rather than on [com.gymie.workout.infrastructure.presentation.web.WorkoutExceptionHandler]:
     * that class lives in `:workout`, which `:groupsession` depends on and not the reverse, so it
     * cannot reference [GroupSessionWorkoutController] without a dependency cycle. Answering the
     * same 404 [com.gymie.workout.infrastructure.presentation.web.WorkoutController] would is what
     * matters, not which module's advice does it — see `group-sessions.md` R11.
     */
    @ExceptionHandler(WorkoutNotFoundException::class)
    fun handleWorkoutNotFound(ex: WorkoutNotFoundException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.message ?: "Workout not found")

    @ExceptionHandler(GroupSessionForbiddenException::class)
    fun handleForbidden(ex: GroupSessionForbiddenException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail
            .forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, ex.message ?: "Edit access to this group session is required")
            .apply { setProperty("code", ex.code) }

    @ExceptionHandler(GroupSessionValidationException::class, WorkoutValidationException::class)
    fun handleValidation(ex: RuntimeException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ex.message ?: "Invalid group session")

    /**
     * `code` per decision `transition-codes` (KAN-757); the two "already" codes also name who got
     * there first and when, so the phone can word a replayed start or finish that lost the race.
     */
    @ExceptionHandler(GroupSessionIllegalTransitionException::class)
    fun handleConflict(ex: GroupSessionIllegalTransitionException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail
            .forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, ex.message ?: "Group session conflict")
            .apply {
                setProperty("code", ex.code)
                val prefix =
                    when (ex.code) {
                        GroupSessionIllegalTransitionException.ALREADY_STARTED -> "started"
                        GroupSessionIllegalTransitionException.ALREADY_FINISHED -> "finished"
                        else -> return@apply
                    }
                setProperty("${prefix}At", ex.at)
                // Omitted, not null, for a session from before the actor was recorded: ProblemDetail's
                // NON_EMPTY inclusion drops a null property, so the client reads absence as unknown.
                ex.actorId?.let { setProperty("${prefix}By", actorOf(it)) }
            }

    /** `{id, displayName}` -- how every 409 here names who got there first. */
    private fun actorOf(userId: UUID): Map<String, Any?> =
        mapOf(
            "id" to userId,
            "displayName" to queryService.profileOf(userId)?.displayName,
        )

    @ExceptionHandler(GroupSessionParticipantNotEligibleException::class)
    fun handleNotEligible(ex: GroupSessionParticipantNotEligibleException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail
            .forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, ex.message ?: "Participant not eligible")
            .apply { setProperty("userId", ex.userId) }

    @ExceptionHandler(GroupSessionCopyRefusedException::class)
    fun handleCopyRefused(ex: GroupSessionCopyRefusedException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, ex.message ?: "Copy refused")

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException::class)
    fun handleBeanValidation(ex: MethodArgumentNotValidException): ProblemDetail = beanValidationProblemDetail(ex)

    /**
     * Mapped here rather than relying on [com.gymie.workout.infrastructure.presentation.web.WorkoutExceptionHandler]
     * for the same reason [handleWorkoutNotFound] is: `:workout`'s advice does not cover
     * [GroupSessionWorkoutController], which raises this from the participant `PUT`.
     */
    @ExceptionHandler(WorkoutStaleException::class)
    fun handleStale(ex: WorkoutStaleException): ProblemDetail =
        ProblemDetail
            .forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, ex.message ?: "Workout changed")
            .apply { setProperty("etag", ETagWebConverter.toETag(ex.currentUpdatedAt)) }
}
